rejectedAttempts.reason: No fully transparent pixels in the native PNG; the background retained alpha near 16. Excluded from delivery, then corrected with a new ImageGen edit. No CPU alpha thresholding or pixel editing was applied.

technicalGates.actualMarginNote: Measured at alpha >= 16: minimum visible margins are 30, 18 and 15 pixels for the three pages. Every complete silhouette stays in its 512 x 512 cell. The requested 8 percent target is not uniform; all cells exceed the 8 pixel atlas minimum.

visualReview.roleReadability: Six distinct unoccupied structures per page. The rope bridge has three anchoring bases. No animal, patient, operator, ship, gun or cargo reward is added as a game entity.

unusedLayoutAttempts.prompt: Layout-only production sprite atlas EDIT. Preserve EXACTLY the same six objects, their individual designs, component counts, colors, materials, lighting, view and their same six slots. Do not redesign. Canvas stays1536x1024 with a regular3columns x2rows of512squarecells. Current sprites are too close to some cell edges. Make EACH whole object SMALLER within its own cell: maximum object width350pixels AND maximum object height350pixels. Preserve each object's aspect and construction. Center horizontally atcellx256, put its lowest physical foot atcelly430. This creates at least80pixels of clear space on all sides, moreforflatstructures. Do not connect objects or add filler to empty space. Native PNG alpha0 must fill ALL space outside and holes inside each structure. Solid objects opaque nearalpha255 with thin antialiased edge only. REMOVE every background haze/gray/brown opacity and cast floor shadow, not recolor it. NO floor, terrain, labels, borders, text, UI, gridlines, watermark, extra actors/animals/guns/vehicles/cargo. Exactly six entire independent structures as reference, only layout/cutout correction. On the rope bridge, preserve exactly THREE anchoring bases, not four. All tops, feet, antennae and cables fully visible.
unusedLayoutAttempts.reason: Layout experiments completed before freeze. Existing accepted pages preserve their original design geometry and remain the delivered native sources.
